title: Freikorps Stahlhelm militias wearing swastikas

tellings.quote: as they called them and one of them was the stall helm and the steel helmet and on their helmets were emblazen the swastikas.

plain: After the First World War, Germany's volunteer militias, called the Freikorps, are said to have painted swastikas on their helmets, and one group was the Stahlhelm, the "steel helmet". Peter Levenda, a writer on the history of intelligence and the occult, tells Michels this without naming a source. It matters because it would place the swastika in German nationalist politics before the Nazis made it theirs.
